snapshots.change_record: First snapshot of study-interim/1: the 951 parts the collectors read on 2026-11-10 under the rule in force since 2026-10-09 (every hosted and activation-patching part outside the hand-authored sets, and the 409 pinned CPU-logits parts). No input and no published file was changed. The published data/model_stats.json dates from 2026-08-29 and does not equal a recomputation over these inputs; outputs.reproduces_from_inputs lists the fields. The collector also takes 11 qwen3-4b rows from the site payload at keys whose engine parts are outside the pin.

Bug correction only. The gallery payload's summary.penalty was not phrase-deduplicated (docs/corrections/payload_summary_dedupe_20261110.md); it is recomputed from the payload's own 1,774 scenarios: n_phrases 1163 to 1124, mean_phrase_deduped -0.0387 to -0.0367, ci95 [-0.0477, -0.0291] to [-0.046, -0.0267]. No scenario, no other statistics file, no pin and no membership rule changed. The parts list is the membership at this engine commit, which includes parts that landed on main on 2026-11-10; no statistics file was regenerated from them.
